blogs.title: Why I prefer to build even confused?
blogs.description: This is your sign to work, even if confused. Least you aren't confused with your dreams.
blogs.longDescription: I am also confused with the future. Every passing day, month; reminds me of not working enough towards where I see myself. But, this shouldn't stop you from actually getting there. Aim for working at get the clear image.
